A '''street urchin''' sat outside a [[Unidentified cantina (Lau)|cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Lau]].<ref name="ADA" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|304}}</ref> the [[Cloning|clones]] [[Crosshair]] and [[Omega]] crashed on the planet after escaping imprisonment by the [[Galactic Empire]]. They entered the cantina while being watched by the urchin. A little later, he watched [[Mann]] leaving towards the cargo docks, having snatched the clones' [[lurca hound]] [[Batcher]]. When Omega and Crosshair emerged, he offered this information for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. However, when intimidated by Crosshair, the boy lowered the fee to 5,000 credits. When he gave the clones the information for the money, he left.<ref name="ADA" />
